records.subject: How's the first week going?
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Good to see North Ventures has a real project going. Let me know if you want a second pair of eyes on how it's structured.

Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get North Ventures set up
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for signing up for Wrenfield. Two things that help teams get going: create a project, and invite at least one teammate from Account Settings -> Members.

Happy to answer anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: New signup alert -- *North Ventures* just created a workspace on starter.

decisions.rationale: Admin replied unprompted and stated intent to add the team (email:4941e29b), and first project was already created on day 0, showing real usage. But no invite sent 6 days in and key milestone unreached; 8 days left. Engaged but passive, so roughly even odds.

draft.subject: Re: How's the first week going?
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for the reply - glad North Ventures likes it so far, and getting the rest of the team in is a good next step. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and if you'd rather not do them one by one, teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead.

If it's helpful, I can walk through adding the team with you on a short call this week - just tell me a time that suits and I'll work around it.

Best,
Chidi
